martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, not great for running today with the heat and possible rain, but it's perfect swimming weather - 27°C and dry conditions make 15:00–17:00 the ideal time to hit the water. Surprise Britt with a swim when they get home from their shift, it's a great way to unwind. The wind is moderate, but it won't bother you in the pool.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, swimming wins today with great conditions from 15:00–17:00, temps around 27°C and dry. Not the best for cycling with that noticeable headwind, but if you're up for it, try to get out early, around 07:00–09:00. Maybe surprise Martha with a swim when she gets home, sounds like a great way to unwind after a long week.
